test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They are constructing a new building in the city centre.

options.text: A new building is being constructed by them in the city centre.
They will construct a new building in the city centre.
The construction of a new building in the city centre by them is ongoing
They constructed a new building in the city centre.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Continuous Tense and Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• **Structure:**
 
 
• **Subject + am/is/are + (Verb+ing) + Object (Active Voice) **
 
• **Object + am/is/are + being+ V3 + by + Subject (Passive Voice)**
 
 
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and **"They"** is the subject and **"a new building"** is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject "They" of the passive voice becomes the object, and the object "a new building" becomes the subject.
 
• "A new building" is a **singular **subject. Hence it will take a singular verb **'is'.**
 
• The verb **"are constructing"** will change into **"are being constructed"**.

Therefore, the correct passive voice is*** "A new building is being constructed by them in the city centre."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In voice change, **TENSE** will never change.
 
• Be careful of the number of the object. Change the verb as per the number of the object.
